generator_version_finding: The author-designated public generator is satwik77/incontext-bool@a25a2cb. Its core task implementations are functionally equivalent to the camera-ready supplementary archive. No released branch can reproduce several conflicting main-table task definitions, so the private generator/config actually used for those rows is not uniquely recoverable.
interpretation: Function repetition is not the same as repeated prompts because input sequences are resampled. It does, however, invalidate a function-disjoint generalization interpretation for classes with material overlap.
protocol_finding: There is no function-disjoint train/test split. Training and evaluation draw fresh functions independently from the same discrete distribution.

released_artifact_mismatches.code: SparseDisjunction hard-codes k=4 and only positive weights.
released_artifact_mismatches.paper: Sparse Disjunction uses at most k=3 signed literals, but states C(50,3)*3^3=529,200 functions and calls this at least one million. The unique truth-table count is sum_{j=0}^3 C(50,j)*2^j=161,801.

released_artifact_mismatches.code: SparseParity hard-codes k=2; no k argument is consumed.
SparseThreshold samples weights with probabilities [0.7,0.15,0.15] and six half-integer thresholds -2.5,...,2.5.
released_artifact_mismatches.paper: 0-1 Threshold samples weights uniformly and b in {-3,...,3}.
